1301	async function loadJoinRequestRecords(db: Db, companyId: string) {
1302	  const rows = collapseDuplicatePendingHumanJoinRequests(
1303	    await db
1304	      .select()
1305	      .from(joinRequests)
1306	      .where(eq(joinRequests.companyId, companyId))
1307	      .orderBy(desc(joinRequests.createdAt))
1308	  );
1309	  const inviteIds = [...new Set(rows.map((row) => row.inviteId))];
1310	  const inviteRows = inviteIds.length
1311	    ? await db
1312	        .select()
1313	        .from(invites)
1314	        .where(inArray(invites.id, inviteIds))
1315	    : [];
1316	  const userIds = [
1317	    ...new Set(
1318	      [
1319	        ...rows.map((row) => row.requestingUserId),
1320	        ...rows.map((row) => row.approvedByUserId),
1321	        ...rows.map((row) => row.rejectedByUserId),
1322	        ...inviteRows.map((invite) => invite.invitedByUserId),
1323	      ].filter((value): value is string => Boolean(value)),
1324	    ),
1325	  ];
1326	  const userMap = await loadUsersById(db, userIds);
1327	  const inviteMap = new Map(inviteRows.map((invite) => [invite.id, invite]));
1328	
1329	  return rows.map((row) => {
1330	    const invite = inviteMap.get(row.inviteId) ?? null;
1331	    return {
1332	      ...toJoinRequestResponse(row),
1333	      requesterUser: row.requestingUserId
1334	        ? userMap.get(row.requestingUserId) ?? null
1335	        : null,
1336	      approvedByUser: row.approvedByUserId
1337	        ? userMap.get(row.approvedByUserId) ?? null
1338	        : null,
1339	      rejectedByUser: row.rejectedByUserId
1340	        ? userMap.get(row.rejectedByUserId) ?? null
1341	        : null,
1342	      invite: invite
1343	        ? {
1344	            id: invite.id,
1345	            inviteType: invite.inviteType,
1346	            allowedJoinTypes: invite.allowedJoinTypes,
1347	            humanRole: extractInviteHumanRole(invite),
1348	            inviteMessage: extractInviteMessage(invite),
1349	            createdAt: invite.createdAt,
1350	            expiresAt: invite.expiresAt,
1351	            revokedAt: invite.revokedAt,
1352	            acceptedAt: invite.acceptedAt,
1353	            invitedByUser: invite.invitedByUserId
1354	              ? userMap.get(invite.invitedByUserId) ?? null
1355	              : null,
1356	          }
1357	        : null,
1358	    };
1359	  });
1360	}
